value.title: ODA Connect - The right personnel at the right time
value.main_text_excerpt:
The right personnel – at the right time
Job seekers
As an employee of Oda Connect AS, you are employed by us, working for one of our customers. The work can vary from short-term temp contracts to permanent positions. We aim to supply skilled personnel to our customers. We are always on the lookout for anyone with the skills or experience within the fields we operate.
WHAT WE OFFER
- Highly competitive terms
- Good insurance and pension schemes.
- Varied working environment
- Optional flexible working hours
- Courses and training
- The opportunity to work in an exciting region for leaders within specialist areas.
Register Your cv With us.
We recommend all jobseekers to register their CV with us. We can then contact you when and if we have a job that suits your profile.
press the symbol below to register CV.
VACANCIES
Employers
Hiring
Contact Oda Connect for the right personnel at the right time. Our personnel solutions are flexible and customised for our customers.
Hiring personnel is useful for temp cover, projects and periods of peak activity. We handle the entire recruitment process, leaving our customers free to focus on their core business.
Oda Connect take full employer responsibility. We hold performance review interviews and personnel management. Candidates are employed by us, and we pay their wages and holiday pay, deduct tax, employer contributions, insurance and pension contributions.
When relevant, we arrange accommodation, travel, work clothes and personal protective equipment.
Recruitment
We can help with all or part of the recruitment process for permanent employment positions. Oda Connect ensures quality and profitability via our participation in the recruitment process. We manage a thorough process to find the best candidate for any given vacancy.
What we can help with
- Defining the requirement profile
- Media plan and advertising
- Assessment of candidates
- Interviews
- Quality assurance
- Recommendations
- Follow-up after employment by the customer
About us
Oda Connect AS is a Norwegian recruitment company in Møre og Romsdal and Trøndelag. The company's head office is in Sunndalsøra, with branches in Oppdal and Kristiansund.
We supply recruitment services to the private and public sectors. We offer two services: Hiring temp personnel and recruitment for permanent employment. We supply personnel within the industrial, construction, oil and gas, electricity and mechanical sectors, the health sector and other service industry sectors. We recruit personnel from Sweden, Iceland, Poland and Norway. We recruit personnel at all levels.
We have a quality management system in accordance with the ISO 9001 standard.
Sectors
Oda Connect offers contract personnel and recruitment within most disciplines and sectors. We have defined certain areas in which our consultants and personnel have specialist skills and experience.
Construction
We supply personnel for all types of building projects. Our customers vary from large, national contractors to small local building companies.
Skills: Joiners, concrete workers, bricklayers, pipelayers and auxiliary personnel.
Oil and gas
Our customers in the oil and gas industry are primarily oil service companies. Our personnel perform offshore and land-based work within maintenance and modification.
Skills: NDT (levels 2 and 3), riggers, fire wardens, industrial mechanics, industrial pipelayers, sheet metal and welding.
Healthcare
Oda Connect supply healthcare personnel to the public and private health services. Our personnel speak Scandinavian languages, and are SAFH authorised.
Skills: Nurses, auxiliary nurses and dentists.
Electrical and mechanical
We have extensive experience from working within these sectors. Our customers are mechanical companies working within industry, electrical contractors and installation companies who need personnel within industry, service and installation.
Skills: Sheet metal workers, industrial mechanics, CNC operators, electrical fitters (DSB), switchboard builders, industrial pipelayers and auxiliary personnel.
Other skills areas
Oda Connect also have experience within the hiring and recruitment of personnel within office work, administration, cleaning and other service industry sectors.
